items.anchor_event: delivery of each Generator Fuel Payment invoice
items.description: Tenant must pay each Generator Fuel Payment as Additional Rent within thirty days after the invoice is delivered.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay the Generator Fuel Payment to Landlord, as Additional Rent, within thirty (30) days of delivery of each Generator Fuel Payment invoice.

items.description: Landlord may bill the Generator Fuel Payment no more often than monthly.
items.span_text: Landlord shall bill Tenant not more frequently than monthly for the amount of the Generator Fuel Payment.

items.description: Both parties must use good faith efforts to resolve billing disputes within thirty calendar days.
items.span_text: Landlord and Tenant shall exercise good faith efforts to resolve all billing disputes to their mutual satisfaction within thirty (30) calendar days.

items.description: Tenant must pay all equipment taxes at least ten days before they become delinquent.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be liable for and shall pay at least ten (10) days before delinquency all Taxes – Equipment.

items.description: If Landlord elects to pay equipment taxes assessed against it or the Property, Tenant must reimburse its share as Additional Rent within thirty days of demand.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay to Landlord as Additional Rent, within thirty (30) days of Landlord’s demand therefor, that part of such Taxes – Equipment for which Tenant is liable hereunder.
items.trigger: If any such Taxes – Equipment are levied or assessed against Landlord or the Property, and if Landlord elects to pay the same

items.description: Tenant must pay Other Taxes to Landlord as Additional Rent within thirty days of demand, in the manner Landlord directs.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay to Landlord, as Additional Rent and within thirty (30) days of Landlord’s demand therefor, and in such manner and at such times as Landlord shall direct from time to time by written notice to Tenant all Taxes – Other.

items.description: Tenant must pay its proportionate share of actual real property taxes as Additional Rent when they exceed the base year amount.
items.span_text: If the Taxes – Real Property (Actual) during any calendar year are greater than the Taxes – Real Property (Actual) applicable to the Tax Base Year, Tenant shall be obligated to pay to Landlord as Additional Rent an amount equal to Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes – Real Property (Actual).
items.trigger: If the Taxes – Real Property (Actual) during any calendar year are greater than the Taxes – Real Property (Actual) applicable to the Tax Base Year

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant a statement of projected real property taxes for the year the Effective Date occurs.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide to Tenant a statement of the Taxes – Real Property (Projected) for the Property for the year in which the Effective Date occurs.

items.description: Tenant must pay each projected real property tax installment on the first day of each month during the Term.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay each Projected Real Property Tax Installment to Landlord on the first day of each month during the Term of the Lease.

items.description: Landlord must provide an annual reconciliation statement of actual versus projected real property taxes by June 15 after each calendar year, or as soon as reasonably possible.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide Tenant a statement on or before June 15 (or as soon thereafter as reasonably possible) after the end of each calendar year, showing Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes – Real Property (Actual) applicable to such calendar year, as compared to the total of the Projected Real Property Tax Installments for such calendar year.

items.description: Tenant must pay any excess of its actual share over projected installments within thirty calendar days after receiving the statement.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay to Landlord, within thirty (30) calendar days following Tenant’s receipt of such statement, the amount of such excess.
items.trigger: If Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes – Real Property (Actual) for such calendar year exceeds the aggregate of the Projected Real Property Tax Installments collected by Landlord from Tenant with regard to such calendar year

items.description: Landlord must refund any overpayment of projected installments within thirty calendar days after Tenant receives the statement.
items.span_text: Landlord shall pay to Tenant, within thirty (30) calendar days following Tenant’s receipt of such statement, the amount of such excess.
items.trigger: if Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes – Real Property (Actual) for such calendar year is less than the aggregate of the Projected Real Property Tax Installments collected by Landlord from Tenant with regard to such calendar year

items.anchor_event: Landlord actually receives the proceeds of such abatement
items.description: Landlord must credit or pay Tenant its share of net tax abatement proceeds within thirty days after actually receiving them.
items.span_text: then Landlord shall, within thirty (30) days after Landlord actually receives the proceeds of such abatement, credit or pay to Tenant with Tenant’s Proportionate Share of the net (i.e. net of the reasonable costs incurred by Landlord in obtaining such abatement) amount of such abatement proceeds
items.trigger: If Landlord receives an abatement of Taxes – Real Property for any fiscal/tax year in respect of which Tenant pays Tenant’s Proportionate Share of Taxes – Real Property

items.description: Tenant must use the Tenant Space only for the Permitted Use.
items.span_text: Tenant shall use the Tenant Space only for the Permitted Use.
